uutiset.t: JSE Courts Dangote Refinery Secondary Listing in Expansion Push
uutiset.s: Africa’s biggest stock exchange is working with Dangote Group to pave the way for a potential secondary listing of its giant oil refinery in Johannesburg, an outcome the bourse’s chief said would be the ideal next step after its landmark Nigerian initial public offering.

uutiset.t: Russia Extends Jet Fuel Export Ban to March on Refinery Attacks
uutiset.s: Russia extended a ban on most jet fuel exports by four months through March to keep its domestic market supplied as Ukraine continues to attack the country’s refineries.

uutiset.t: Rwanda Wins F1 Hosting Rights in Bet on Tourism
uutiset.s: Rwanda has been chosen to host Formula 1’s return to Africa, beating competition from South Africa and Morocco. uutiset.t: Kospi Rout Wipes $151 Billion From Korea Pension Fund’s Assets
uutiset.s: South Korea’s National Pension Service saw its assets shrink by about 202 trillion won ($151.4 billion) in the third quarter as a stock-market retreat eroded some of the out-sized gains accumulated earlier this year.

uutiset.t: Dubai Stocks Erase Wartime Losses to Become a Top Gulf Performer
uutiset.s: Dubai stocks have erased all losses since the Iran war began, transforming from the Gulf’s biggest laggard into one of its best performers, driven by government support and resilient economic activity.

uutiset.t: China Bank Bond Spreads Head for Biggest Jump in Over Two Years
uutiset.s: Chinese bank bond spreads are heading for their biggest monthly increase since September 2024, as debt strain at a major state-owned conglomerate ripples through the broader credit market.

uutiset.t: Hong Kong Dollar Hits Six-Month High as Funding Costs Climb
uutiset.s: The Hong Kong dollar extended its rally to a six-month high, propelled by surging local borrowing costs and demand from investors snapping up the city’s equities amid a rally in Chinese stocks.

uutiset.t: Qatar’s LNG Export Push Provides Lifeline to South Asian Buyers
uutiset.s: Qatar’s efforts to export more liquefied natural gas through the Strait of Hormuz are already saving money for South Asia’s cash-strapped importers of the super-chilled fuel.

uutiset.t: China Drives Biggest Stock Gain Since 2024 With Rare Midday Vow
uutiset.s: Chinese authorities gave markets a boost with a rare midday statement pledging support, sending stocks to their best day in more than two years.

uutiset.t: Emerging Stocks Head for Biggest Weekly Gain Since June
uutiset.s: Emerging-market stocks headed for their biggest weekly gain since June as investors piled back into technology shares after a recent selloff.

uutiset.t: Copper Surges the Most in 10 Months as Risk Appetite Returns
uutiset.s: Copper surged the most since January, extending its rebound from an 11-month low as risk appetite returned after a rout fueled by concerns over the AI trade.

uutiset.t: Gold Rises as Rebound in Tech Stocks Helps Revive Risk Appetite
uutiset.s: Gold rose as a rally in stocks helped the precious metal recover from a rout that sent prices to a 15-month low.
